decisions.reason: Established failure of the declared ERC criterion: 353 violations across ten sheet instances, including five unexcluded errors. Exit zero establishes successful execution, not compliance. These are native rule/documentation defects; missing power-output annotations and tied module power-output pin types do not independently prove absent supplies or regulator contention.

Established failure of the declared DRC criterion: 142 board violations and 114 parity issues remain. All 13 severity-error entries have saved exclusions; 94 board warnings remain unexcluded. Preserve those exceptions without claiming unwaived manufacturing failures. Zero unconnected items and matching numbered-pad nets do not make rule/parity checks pass. Saved copper was not refilled.

Established operating-range incompatibility under the stated Polygonus GPIO-high condition. Native schematic and saved board connect these eight SOT-223 N3 inputs through 1k resistors to direct 3.3 V MCU signals. Their input also supplies the device; both identified N3 parts require at least 3.5 V. Even ideal drive has −0.2 V margin before drops. Guaranteed turn-on is unsupported; universal switching failure or damage is not asserted. See [ST VNL5090 Tables 2/6/8](https://www.st.com/resource/en/datasheet/vnl5090n3-e.pdf).

decisions.reason: The major concern remains materially unresolved. Native populated resistors establish an unloaded 2.5 V bias with 1.5k source resistance, overlapping the N3 threshold interval. The independent resistor-only simulation confirms that calculation. Driver/A1 loading, actual GPIO reset behavior, sequencing duration and actuator response remain unknown; actual unwanted conduction is neither established nor excluded. This cannot be reduced to a minor observation or treated as a behavioral pass.

decisions.reason: The identity conflict is confirmed: native value VNL5090 and LCSC C2680415 disagree with the [supplier's VNL5050N3TR-E mapping](https://item.szlcsc.com/2772332.html). Preserve it as a minor documentation/procurement concern. No declared device-dependent performance target or purchasing-field criterion, and no harmful substitution mechanism, establishes a separate defect. The operating-range defect remains accepted under either identity.
